# FIGURES {#sec-figures}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_setup.R")
```

Each figure below is the image saved with the version's figure PDF (`output/nca/v`r nca_version`/figures/`), checked against the hash in the provenance record, with every page shown. Captions are the descriptions recorded in the provenance record.

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in spec$outputs$figures) {
  name <- output_name(e)
  cap <- md_escape(e$description %||% name)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", cap))
  cat(sprintf("Source: `%s` (script `%s/%s.R`)\n\n", e$path, spec$script_dir, name))
  if (grepl("\\.png$", e$path)) {
    # versions made before figures moved to the TLF shell saved a PNG only
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s){width=100%%}\n\n\\clearpage\n\n", cap, fig_file(basename(e$path))))
    next
  }
  display <- fig_display(name)
  n_pages <- if (inherits(display, "PNG")) 1L else length(display)
  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
    page_cap <- if (n_pages > 1) sprintf("%s (page %d of %d)", cap, i, n_pages) else cap
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s){width=100%%}\n\n\\clearpage\n\n", page_cap, qc_figure(name, i, display = display)))
  }
}
```
